knownFailures.rootCause: GitHub Actions on push runs only after the main ref has already changed; without native branch/ruleset protection it is detection, not pre-write prevention.
knownFailures.fix: Keep candidate-only delivery mandatory, classify any direct main write as a governance incident, and retain the native main-protection hard boundary until fresh GitHub evidence proves pre-write enforcement.

knownFailures.rootCause: An unprotected main can accept a one-parent/manual/test write that bypasses candidate PR verification even when post-push memory CI later detects it.
knownFailures.fix: Do not silently accept the write as governed delivery. Read current main, preserve useful content only through a fresh candidate when needed, verify downstream production parity, record incident evidence, and keep native protection remediation open until direct writes are structurally impossible.
